card.title: Verify the team's email address on Cloudflare?
card.context: Cloudflare will not send the team's mail from the new address until the account owner verifies it. You own the account.
card.question: Should the new team email address be verified so mail can go out from it?

choices.label: Yes, verify it
choices.effect: mail from the team address starts working today
choices.pros: customers get replies from the team address

choices.label: Not now
choices.effect: mail keeps going from personal addresses

card.why: It is the last thing holding the team address.
card.after_press: Paste your password and the agent finishes it; its check sees the address verified.

owner_step.label: Give the agent your Cloudflare sign-in
steps: Answer this card in your own words with your Cloudflare email and password.
The agent signs in as you and presses Verify.

input.verify: cf email routing addresses list --json | jq -e 'map(select(.verified)) | length > 0'
